scripts.setup_environment: (pnpm i) && (pnpm run setup:env) && (pnpm run setup:python) && (docker compose -p takeinitiative -f compose.dev.yml up -d postgres)
scripts.dev: pnpm run setup_environment && (pnpm turbo run dev --ui tui)
scripts.api: pnpm run setup_environment && (pnpm turbo watch dev --filter=@ti/api)
scripts.web: pnpm run setup_environment && (pnpm turbo watch dev --filter=@ti/web)
